events.summary: README expands E-PQ feedback, per-entity vectors, six scheduling gates, logs, DBs and resource use. Useful historical architecture surface but includes known self-reinforcing metric semantics and is not itself runtime proof.

Replaces five fixed timers/pairwise scheduling with one idle-driven dispatcher, daily quotas, serial execution, explicit exit reasons and non-counting user_returned interruptions; notifications gain durable persistence.
Import reload duplicated log handlers and exact exit-reason matching misclassified detailed outcomes; adds handler idempotency and prefix-aware outcome parsing.
All message classes persist with role preserved while system messages stay out of LLM context; agentic LLM calls move to a cancellable sub-thread with 0.5s polling.
Responsive bubble reflow plus same system-message persistence and cancel semantics; mostly corroborates k445 with UI-specific resize handling.
Replaces 30-60s uninterruptible entity sleeps with 5s idle polling so user return aborts background sessions promptly and avoids ghost GPU load.
Dispatcher polling interval increased from 60s to 600s, demonstrating scheduler responsiveness/resource overhead is an explicit policy tradeoff.

Installer rewritten to match 25+ service architecture, build llama/whisper, separate venvs, GPU backends, voice/models and systemd units. Historical packaging topology becomes reproducible deployment evidence.
Wake-word voice daemon removed from watchdog and disabled while PTT remains; demonstrates monitored-service set must match intended active topology rather than resurrect deprecated services.
Adds terminal installation wizard and PyInstaller standalone packaging surface; mainly deployment/UX evidence.
Voice requests reset stale cancel state; narrative multi-step text requires an action verb before entering agentic mode, reducing effect-routing false positives.
README reconciled to 24+ services, PTT-only voice and centralized entity dispatcher and adds autonomous-system caution. Documentation remains descriptive, not proof of phenomenal or emergent claims.
README install link updated to packaged release binary.

Floating topmost overlay replaced by X11 DOCK/strut contract, deleting large amounts of manual fullscreen/position enforcement. Useful principle: delegate spatial authority to the platform primitive when available rather than maintaining competing local control loops.

Adds visible hardware telemetry, removes live-wallpaper service/autostart/watchdog and generates static resolution-aware wallpaper. Confirms decommissioned services must be removed from recovery topology.

Download detector previously marked ineligible old/small files known before notification, causing silent misses; fixes eligibility-before-known-state transition and adds explicit filepath effect affordance.

Documents six distributed memory/persistence layers, data flow, schemas and retrieval strategies. Valuable archaeology/index source but all implementation claims require runtime/source verification before promotion.

cross_branch_findings: Centralized arbitration is superior to pairwise exclusion, but scheduler outcomes, quotas and interruption reasons must be typed rather than stringly parsed.
Reload/restart semantics must be idempotent across handlers, workers and state registration; a valid central dispatcher can still duplicate side effects after module reload.
Persistent system events may be UI-visible/replayable without being LLM conversational context. Persistence class, context-admission class and action affordances are separate dimensions.
Cancellation and user-return preemption must propagate through actual blocking waits and inference calls with bounded latency; checking only between logical turns is insufficient.
Scheduler polling frequency is a measured cost/latency policy, not an implementation constant; Harness should report missed-opportunity latency and resource duty cycle.
Recovery/watchdog topology must track intended service lifecycle. Removed/parked/deprecated services must not be revived merely because a process is absent.
Platform-native authority primitives can collapse fragile local feedback loops: the X11 DOCK/strut migration replaced hundreds of lines of manual topmost/fullscreen enforcement.
State-machine admission order matters: marking an event/resource known before eligibility/receipt creation can permanently suppress a legitimate effect.
Deployment/install manifests are architecture evidence and should be mechanically diffed against actual service/runtime topology.
Memory architecture documentation is a navigation surface, not a truth source; current UnifiedDB should retain source/runtime evidence links per claimed layer.

credit.reason: Sub-denominator semantic closure only; scheduler/liveness/deployment/memory findings overlap existing architecture and Harness mappings and require row-level dedup.
